dct_title_s: Gridded Population Estimates for Yemen using UN COD-PS Estimates 2019, 2023 and 2024, version 1.0
dct_description_sm: These data were produced by [ WorldPop](https://www.worldpop.org/) at the University of Southampton and [ World Bank Group ](https://www.worldbank.org/en/home). These data include gridded estimates of population at approximately 100m for 2019, 2023 and 2024 along with estimates of the number of people belonging to individual age-gender groups. These results were produced using subnational population estimates for Yemen provided in the Common Operational Dataset on Population Statistics (2019, 2023 [COD-PS](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/yemen-population-estimates) and 2024 [COD-PS](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/yemen-humanitarian-needs-overview) ) and Subnational Administrative Boundaries for Yemen provided by [OCHA](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-yem). For further details, please, read the [Release Statement](https://data.worldpop.org/repo/prj/WP_WB/YEM/v1/release_statement.pdf). **Recommended citations** WorldPop and World Bank Group. 2024 *Gridded population estimates for Yemen using UN COD-PS estimates 2019, 2023 and 2024, version 1.0*. https://data.worldpop.org/repo/prj/WP_WB/YEM/v1/ **License** *These data may be distributed using a Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0) License, specified in legal code.
